将车开到李月芽小区门口，吴姜探出头，对着已经下车的她问道：“用不用我送你回学校？”

李月芽摇了摇头，说道：“不用，我自己坐地铁过去就行。”

吴姜没勉强，摆了摆手，启动车子，回了自己家小区。

一进门，家里安安静静的，吴时安和王雅琴都没回来。吴时安不用说，一定是在古玩城，王雅琴估摸着也去店里帮他打理账本了。

往常只要吴时安进货回来，王雅琴都会帮着核对账目、整理货物。

吴姜往沙发上一躺，掏出手机，给阮柏云发了一条消息。

他是想询问念念的死亡原因，上午因为念念就在身边，他不方便问出口，生怕勾起小丫头的伤心事。

消息刚发出去，很快，阮柏云就回复了。

“那是十多天前的事情了，我和你嫂子，本来是打算带念念去水上乐园玩的，她央求了好久的。可没想到，快到地方的时候，路上出了车祸，我和你嫂子都没什么大事，可念念却......”

后面的话，阮柏云终究没忍心打出来，但吴姜也能想象到，当时的场景有多令人痛心。

他也终于明白，念念怎么会在水上乐园里面了，而不是留在车祸现场或者车里，因为她的执念，就是和爸爸妈妈去水上乐园里面玩。

吴姜安慰了阮柏云几句，让他不用太过自责，就结束了和他的聊天。

昨晚因为念念的事情没有睡好，这会儿困意涌上来，吴姜打着哈欠回房间补觉去了。

正睡的迷迷糊糊的时候，外面传来开门和说话的声音，吴姜揉着惺忪的睡眼走出房间，果然是老爸老妈回来了。

“我一猜就是你小子回来了，我车位上停的那辆新车，就是你买的？”吴时安看到儿子，语气带着点吐槽问道。

Driving the car to the gate of Li Yueya's community, Wu Jiang stuck his head out and asked her who had already gotten out of the car: "Do you need me to take you back to school?"

Li Yueya shook her head and said, "No, I can just take the subway there myself."

Wu Jiang didn't force it, waved his hand, started the car, and returned to his home community.

As soon as he entered the door, the house was quiet. Wu Shi'an and Wang Yaqin didn't come back.Needless to say, Wu Shi'an must be in the antique city, and Wang Yaqin probably went to the store to help him take care of the books.

Usually, whenever Wu Shi'an comes back from purchasing goods, Wang Yaqin will help check the accounts and organize the goods.

Wu Jiang lay down on the sofa, took out his mobile phone, and sent a message to Ruan Boyun.

He wanted to ask about the cause of Nian Nian's death. Since Nian Nian was by his side in the morning, it was inconvenient for him to ask, for fear of arousing the little girl's sadness.

As soon as the message was sent, Ruan Boyun responded quickly.

"That happened more than ten days ago. Your sister-in-law and I originally planned to take Niannian to the water park. She had been begging for a long time. But unexpectedly, when we were about to get there, there was a car accident on the road. Your sister-in-law and I were fine, but Niannian..."

Ruan Boyun couldn't bear to type out the rest of the words, but Wu Jiang could also imagine how painful the scene was at that time.

He finally understood why Nian Nian was in the water park instead of staying at the scene of the car accident or in the car, because her obsession was to go to the water park with her parents.

Wu Jiang comforted Ruan Boyun a few words, telling him not to blame himself too much, and ended the chat with him.

She didn't sleep well last night because of Nian Nian's affairs, and now she was feeling sleepy. Wu Jiang yawned and went back to the room to catch up on some sleep.

While he was drifting off to sleep, the sound of opening the door and talking came from outside. Wu Jiang rubbed his sleepy eyes and walked out of the room. Sure enough, his parents were back.

"I guess your kid is back. Did you buy the new car parked in my parking space?" Wu Shi'an asked with a bit of ridicule in his tone when he saw his son.
